name: browser-forest
description: Anti-detect cloud browser MCP — kernel-patched Chromium bypasses DataDome/PerimeterX/Cloudflare; AI behavior layer drives human-like clicks. Cloud browser API for AI agents.

auth.description: Your Browser Forest API key (starts with bf_live_). Generate one from the dashboard at https://browserforest.com/dashboard/keys

tools.name: bf_create_session
tools.description: Create an anti-detect browser session (optional url/proxy/contextId), returns CDP-ready session

tools.name: bf_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a URL and wait for load (domcontentloaded + network idle)

tools.name: bf_extract
tools.description: Extract page content by selector (markdown or structured)

tools.name: bf_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page, returns base64 PNG

tools.name: bf_click
tools.description: Click an element with the AI behavior engine (isTrusted + human trajectory)

tools.name: bf_fill
tools.description: Fill a form field with the AI behavior engine (human-like typing)

tools.name: bf_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility snapshot (AX tree + refs) for AI behavior engine input
